purpose: Audit whether the factory has the right workers/agents and skill providers to execute world-class product processes, preserving modular adaptive capability acquisition.
public_private_boundary: Productized public registry only; raw studies, chat context, private runtime smoke logs and local paths stay private.

demand_coverage.recommendation: upgrade product-sot-planner or add opportunity strategist capability
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can produce opportunity brief, JTBD, success metric and non-goals
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: skill/process pack for opportunity framing and JTBD synthesis
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Factory can execute a product without proving the opportunity is real.

demand_coverage.recommendation: strengthen Product SOT planner or add PRD/requirements architect
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can produce PRD-grade functional/non-functional requirements and acceptance criteria
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: PRD/spec-first skill pack with examples and anti-shallow evals
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Product SOT can remain a summary instead of a build-quality requirements contract.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add research/evidence matrix obligations before SOT freeze
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can create research plan, confidence levels and assumption register
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: research synthesis skill pack with evidence grading
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Weak evidence can become frozen scope.

demand_coverage.display_name: User Story Mapping and Flow Model
demand_coverage.recommendation: add flow/story mapping executor or Product Face subcapability
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can map journeys, states, handoffs and edge paths
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: story mapping / service blueprint skill source and templates
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Individual requirements can pass while the real journey is broken.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add system design packet and review gate capability
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can produce concrete system design packet, APIs, data model, tradeoffs and ADRs
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: system design/RFC/ADR skill pack with review rubric
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Architecture remains abstract and misses executable technical decisions.

demand_coverage.recommendation: upgrade Product Face with design review/accessibility gate
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can review visual quality, states, copy, accessibility and design-system consistency
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Product may work but feel generic, confusing or inaccessible.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add analytics planner worker and skill/provider path
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can define event taxonomy, funnels, dashboard spec and decision metrics
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: product analytics/funnel/north-star skill pack from trusted provider
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Factory cannot learn whether shipped products succeed.

demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can define target segment, positioning, channel, activation and launch metric
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: GTM/positioning/growth loop skill pack from trusted provider
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: The factory can build excellent products nobody understands or adopts.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add experiment designer or obligation before overbuilding
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can create falsifiable experiment, decision metric, duration/sample and risk bound
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Factory may build full product before testing the riskiest assumption.

demand_coverage.recommendation: upgrade QA into risk-based strategy, not only verification
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can produce test matrix by risk and evidence type
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Tests remain ad hoc and miss product-critical failures.

demand_coverage.recommendation: strengthen release ops worker with readiness packet
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can verify rollback, monitoring, support, changelog and owner
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: release readiness/SRE operational review skill pack
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Product ships without operational safety or support readiness.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add post-launch review as learnback executor obligation
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can compare metrics/feedback/bugs to success criteria and create method updates
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: post-launch review and learnback skill pack
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Learnback stays internal and misses real-world outcomes.

demand_coverage.recommendation: add data governance/privacy specialist or pack
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can map data inventory, retention, access, privacy boundary and consent/basis
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: privacy/data governance skill pack and checklist
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Secure implementation can still mishandle data governance and privacy.

demand_coverage.display_name: AI Eval and Model Risk Review
demand_coverage.recommendation: add AI eval/model risk executor obligations
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: worker can produce eval plan, golden cases, failure taxonomy, red-team and model/system card
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: AI eval/RAG eval/model risk skill pack
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: AI/agent features can demo well and fail silently or unsafely.

demand_coverage.display_name: Solana Domain Execution via Solana AI Kit
demand_coverage.recommendation: keep Solana AI Kit as the mandatory official domain brain for every Solana/onchain planning or execution path; do not route Solana execution to generic or external non-Solana-AI-Kit agents.
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: Workers must execute Solana tasks only after the Solana AI Kit core pack/domain-brain provider is loaded and recorded, with signer, funds, mainnet and human gates still overriding provider guidance.
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: Solana AI Kit from solanabr/solana-ai-kit remains the mandatory pinned provider for Solana domain knowledge, agents, commands, MCP guidance, Anchor/Pinocchio/Unity/Mobile/security rules and usage receipts.
evidence_or_eval_required: Quasar proof when Quasar lane is used
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Generic agents can make unsafe Solana assumptions, skip signer boundaries, ignore ecosystem-specific guidance or execute onchain work without the approved Solana domain brain.

demand_coverage.recommendation: harden acquisition lane with candidate search, eval, promotion and demotion rules
demand_coverage.needed_executor_capability: orchestrator can trigger acquisition without treating missing capability as immediate human blocker
demand_coverage.needed_skill_capability: trusted provider search plus candidate testing protocol for agents and skills
demand_coverage.risk_if_unfixed: Factory loses modular adaptive promise when new demands lack good executors or skills.

non_goals: do not create agents from vibes
do not turn skills into route authority
do not publish raw studies or private runtime evidence
do not abandon modular adaptive demand routing
